program_name: Online Bachelor of Science in Nursing – RN to BSN

programme_facts.value: Upon graduation, you’ll be equipped to pursue diverse nursing roles in various health care settings, including hospitals, ICUs, labor and delivery, hospices and specialty clinics. A BSN also serves as a stepping stone to advanced degrees, opening doors to careers as a nurse practitioner, nurse anesthetist and more.
